protocol.question: does a disagreement-enriched validation set stabilize threshold+checkpoint selection?

designs.standard: stratified 40-row validation (existing protocol; ~5 informative rows; 40 gold)
designs.disagree_val: 20 disagreements + 10 agreements from unused pool rows plus standard-validation rows (30 gold; ~20 informative)

protocol.training: same protocol as run_sembench_disagree_scale_augment.py but a fresh randomness realization: per-epoch evaluation shifts DataLoader RNG draws, so trajectories are not bit-identical to that file; standard-design aggregates match it within seed noise. Within each run both designs score the same per-epoch models, so the design comparison is exactly paired.
